title: Renewal & Fresh Vision
intro: Small children understand fresh starts better than adults do — they forgive by lunchtime and forget by teatime. This month borrows that and makes it a habit: today is new, sorry works, and you are not stuck being whoever you were this morning.

keyScriptures.text: His mercies are new every morning.
See, I am doing a new thing!

weeks.title: Today Is New
weeks.declaration: Today is a new day. Whatever happened yesterday does not have to come with you into it.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, make every morning here a fresh start. Amen.

weeks.title: You Are Not Stuck
weeks.declaration: You are not stuck being whoever you were this morning. People can change, and you already have.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, help us see who our child is becoming rather than who they were last week. Amen.

weeks.title: Sorry Works
weeks.declaration: Sorry actually works here. It is not just a word you have to say.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, let forgiveness be real in this house, not just a rule. Amen.

weeks.title: Look How You Have Grown
weeks.declaration: You can do things now that you could not do a little while ago. Look how you have grown.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, thank You for how much this child has grown. Help us notice out loud. Amen.

days.title: Today Is New
days.declaration: Today is a new day. Yesterday does not have to come with you.

scripture.text: His mercies are new every morning.

days.title: You Are Not Stuck
days.declaration: You are not stuck being who you were this morning. You can change.

scripture.text: The new creation has come.

days.title: Sorry Works
days.declaration: Sorry really works. It is not just a word you have to say.

scripture.text: He is faithful and just and will forgive us.

days.title: Look How You Have Grown
days.declaration: You can do things now you could not do before. Look at that.

scripture.text: The child grew and became strong.

days.title: Starting Again
days.declaration: You can start again as many times as you need. Nobody is counting.

scripture.text: Though the righteous fall seven times, they rise again.

days.title: God Does New Things
days.declaration: God is always doing something new. Some of it is happening in you.

scripture.text: See, I am doing a new thing!

days.title: A Clean Page
days.declaration: This morning is a clean page. Nothing is written on it yet.

scripture.text: They shall be as white as snow.

days.title: Not the Same as Last Year
days.declaration: You are not the same as you were last year. That is a good thing.

scripture.text: He will carry it on to completion.

days.title: Letting Something Go
days.declaration: There is one thing you can stop carrying today. Put it down.

scripture.text: Let us throw off everything that hinders.

days.title: Forgiving Quickly
days.declaration: You are very good at forgiving quickly. Do not lose that.

scripture.text: Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

days.title: Trying Something New
days.declaration: New things feel funny before they feel normal. That is not a reason to stop.

scripture.text: New things I declare.

days.title: Yesterday Is Finished
days.declaration: Yesterday is finished. It cannot follow you around.

scripture.text: Forgetting what is behind.

days.title: Being Loved While You Change
days.declaration: You are loved the same while you change. Love does not have to catch up.

scripture.text: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

days.title: Good Things Ahead
days.declaration: There are good things coming that have not happened yet.

scripture.text: Plans to give you hope and a future.

days.title: God Is in Tomorrow
days.declaration: God is already in tomorrow. He got there first.

scripture.text: You hem me in behind and before.

days.title: Growing Takes Time
days.declaration: Growing takes ages and it is happening anyway, every day.

scripture.text: The seed sprouts and grows.

days.title: A New Name
days.declaration: God has good names for you that nobody has called you yet.

scripture.text: You will be called by a new name.

days.title: Nobody Is Finished
days.declaration: Nobody in this house is finished. We are all still growing.

scripture.text: Being transformed into his image.

days.title: Hoping Is Allowed
days.declaration: You are allowed to look forward to things. Hoping is a good thing to do.

scripture.text: May the God of hope fill you with all joy.

days.title: Mistakes Do Not Stick
days.declaration: Your mistakes do not stick to you. They get washed off.

scripture.text: As far as the east is from the west.

days.title: Remembering Good Bits
days.declaration: Remembering the good bits of a day is a nice thing to do at bedtime.

scripture.text: I will remember the deeds of the Lord.

days.title: Trying the Hard Thing
days.declaration: The thing you could not do yesterday might work today. Have a go.

scripture.text: I can do all this through him who gives me strength.

days.title: Not Rushing to Grow Up
days.declaration: You do not have to hurry to be big. Being your age is good.

scripture.text: He has made everything beautiful in its time.

days.title: Saying Thank You for the Year
days.declaration: Say thank you for the things that happened. Name a few out loud.

scripture.text: Give thanks in all circumstances.

days.title: Being Braver Than Before
days.declaration: You are braver than you used to be. That keeps happening.

scripture.text: They go from strength to strength.

days.title: Doing One Thing Differently
days.declaration: You can change one thing. One is easier than lots and it works better.

scripture.text: Do not despise these small beginnings.

days.title: Loved All the Way Through
days.declaration: You were loved on every single day, even the horrible ones.

scripture.text: Nothing can separate us from the love of God.

days.title: Walking Into It
days.declaration: We will walk into the new bit rather than run at it. Walking lasts longer.

scripture.text: Walk humbly with your God.

days.title: More Ahead Than Behind
days.declaration: There is much more in front of you than behind you. You have only just started.

scripture.text: Shining ever brighter till the full light of day.

days.title: Still the Same God
days.declaration: Everything changes and God does not. That is why we are not worried.

scripture.text: I the Lord do not change.

days.title: All of It Comes With Us
days.declaration: Everything good you learned comes with you into what is next.

scripture.text: I have made you and I will carry you.
